subject: Renewal roadmap — proposal to compress exec + tech sessions into same day
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <s.ramos@clearmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal roadmap — proposal to compress exec + tech sessions into same day

Hi Sofia —

Congrats again on a strong pilot run. As we discussed last week, we want to make the renewal QBR and roadmap update as low-friction as possible for your execs while still giving the engineering team a substantive technical session.

Proposal (single-day option):
- Morning (09:00–09:45 PT): Executive QBR (metrics, success milestones, renewal terms summary) — 45 minutes, recording permitted
- Late morning (10:15–11:45 PT): Tech deep-dive + ops Q&A (architecture, kv-cache patterns, quantization plan) — 90 minutes
- Proposed dates: Wed Sep 10, Thu Sep 11, or Tue Sep 16 (we can pick one)

Benefits: fewer calendar handoffs for execs, one travel/availability window for the whole stakeholder list, same-day momentum for decisioning.

Attached: proposed_agenda.pdf (one-pager with timeboxes and talking points).

Ask: can you confirm whether the execs prefer a single compressed day or two separate half-days? If single day works, which of the three dates above suits best (or propose alternatives)?

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

---
From: Sofia Ramos <s.ramos@clearmed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearmed.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:40:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap — proposal to compress exec + tech sessions into same day

Karthik, thanks for the clear proposal and the agenda. Quick note from our side: the execs want a lighter touch — they prefer a 30–45 minute summary — but the engineering team needs a full separate deep-dive day to accommodate hands-on run-throughs and our procurement folks may want to join parts of the contract discussion.

Constraints:
- Exec availability: Prefer Tue/Thu mornings in September (30–45 min)
- Eng/ops: need a separate 2–3 hour block to walk through infra and SLOs
- Procurement (looping Alex) will want to review proposed terms; can we include them on the invite or a follow-up?

Can we do this as two half-days? If not possible, provide a compressed single-day plan that gives the eng team the time they need. I can do Wed Sep 10 but only if the deep-dive remains largely after lunch.

Sofia
Director of Platform Operations | ClearMed Health
s.ramos@clearmed.com | +1 617-555-2287

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal roadmap — proposal to compress exec + tech sessions into same day

Karthik / Jonas —

Quick technical read:
- If ClearMed wants substantive ops walkthroughs (live traces, KV cache hotspots, quantization tradeoffs), 90 minutes is tight but doable if we pre-record a 20-min demo and use the session for live Q&A and a short hands-on lab.
- For a same-day format, I recommend the following tweak:
  - Exec QBR: 09:00–09:30 PT (tight 30-min run)
  - Break: 30 minutes with shared recording links
  - Tech deep-dive: 10:00–12:15 PT (2h15 with a 15-min break)

I've attached a short ops checklist that maps topics to presenters (deep-dive-ops-checklist.xlsx). If we compress everything into the afternoon post-exec session, we need Jonas or myself to lead the lab and have a pre-configured sandbox for participant access.

Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <s.ramos@clearmed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap — proposal to compress exec + tech sessions into same day

Sofia —

Thanks for the constraints. Compromise option that might keep execs happy and still give eng the time they need (same-day compressed):
- 09:00–09:30 PT: Exec QBR (30-min tight; recording enabled)
- 11:00–13:00 PT: Technical workshop (2 hours, hands-on; includes 20-min pre-recorded demo)

We can host the workshop hybrid-style; Monica will own the lab and I will cover SLOs/ops. I can create the calendar invite with both timezones visible and add Alex from procurement to the exec invite for the 09:00 slot. Proposed calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=clearmed_qbr_20250910

Presenters:
- Exec QBR: Karthik + Jonas (15 min each)
- Tech workshop: Monica (lab lead) + Jonas (SLOs + architecture)

If that looks good, Karthik — can you lock Sep 10 and send the invite? I will prepare the workshop sandbox and confirm access lists by Aug 25.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ramos <s.ramos@clearmed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearmed.com>, procurement@clearmed.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 14:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap — proposal to compress exec + tech sessions into same day

Karthik / Jonas / Monica —

Thanks — the compromise looks good. ClearMed will take the same-day compressed option on Wed Sep 10. Please send calendar invites:
- Exec QBR: Sep 10, 09:00–09:30 PT (Alex from procurement copied)
- Technical workshop: Sep 10, 11:00–13:00 PT (recording requested; Monica to set up sandbox access)

Procurement requested that you attach the latest SLA/terms summary for pre-review — looping procurement@clearmed.com and Alex for transparency. I attach a short procurement checklist on our side (clearmed_procurement_sla.pdf).

See you then — looking forward to the session and thanks for being flexible on timing.

Best,
Sofia
Director of Platform Operations | ClearMed Health
